THEN run node scripts/impact_registry.mjs --write -- REQUIRED in this cell, not deferred: scripts/impact-registry.json is derived from run_verify.mjs's live SUITES (scripts/impact_registry.mjs:418) and carries a scripts/skill_budget_fence.mjs entry at :3433-3442, and scripts/tests/test_impact_registry.mjs:174 asserts the committed file is byte-identical to a fresh build. The case never runs the target's real logic -- it overwrites the path with process.exit(0) at :314 -- so it needs only a non-empty declaration for that path in verify-cache-inputs.json plus reachability by --only inside the fixture's byte-copied run_verify.mjs. test_misc.mjs is glob-discovered under DISCOVERY_ROOTS (run_verify.mjs:93-98) so it needs no EXTRA_SUITES membership, which retires the exact fragility that broke this case; its declared inputs at scripts/verify-cache-inputs.json:12-16 are AGENTS.md, packages/bee/AGENTS.block.md and skills/**/* so the existing mutations of skills/demo/SKILL.md and skills/second/SKILL.md keep working unchanged. EDIT ALL SIX SITES or the case stays red: (1) :311 const FENCE token -> test_misc; (2) :312 const CACHED_FENCE regex path; (3) :313 const RAN_FENCE regex path; (4) :314 writeFixtureFile stub path -> packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs; (5) :315 writeFixtureFile declared input -> AGENTS.md; (6) :321 cacheEntries(fx8)[...] cache key -> packages/bee/tests/test_misc.mjs. Also update the comments at :76-81 and :304-307 which name the fence and state the deliberate intent that the case rides a REAL declaration not a synthetic stand-in -- keep that intent, name the new target.
